name: Mediclinic Baby Programme

freeDetails: Free registration provides pregnancy and baby information, newsletters, webinars and support, even for parents not delivering at Mediclinic. A separate hospital baby bag is a benefit for members delivering at a Mediclinic facility.

bestFor: Adult Absa Personal Banking clients who use the latest Absa Banking App and receive an Advantage challenge
freeDetails: Absa Advantage offers meal vouchers for completing eligible in-app banking challenges. The official programme page says the vouchers have no minimum spend and can be shared with friends or family.

name: Kauai app birthday reward
bestFor: South African adults who use the Kauai App and complete their date of birth before their birthday
freeDetails: Kauai lists an annual tier-based birthday reward: Green members get any small smoothie, Gold members get any wrap, and Black members get any meal plus any small smoothie.
requirements: Kauai App registration is required for South African citizens aged 18 or older. Complete the profile and date of birth and link a valid payment card; the terms state that a temporary R1 card-verification deduction is reversed.
watchOut: The public terms do not state the birthday reward's redemption window. Check the validity shown in My Vouchers before travelling. Participating-store and product exclusions apply.

freeDetails: A registered member who spent at least R1,000 at Spur in the 12 months before their birthday receives a R50 birthday voucher in their profile on the birthday.
requirements: Register a Spur Family profile in the app and reach R1,000 cumulative qualifying Spur spend during the 12 months before the birthday.
watchOut: This is a spend-linked loyalty voucher, not a no-purchase freebie. It is valid for 31 days, is non-transferable and can only be used by the registered member under the current redemption rules.

name: Bootlegger app registration coffee

requirements: Download the Bootlegger app, create a new account and redeem the registration reward under the current in-app conditions.
watchOut: Check the reward's product choice, validity period and participating cafe availability in the app before travelling. The separate stamp reward requires ten purchases.

name: Telkom R550 customer referral credit

freeDetails: Telkom's current customer-referral terms offer the referrer R550 account credit after a successful referred order is put into service.

name: SA Youth work and learning support

freeDetails: Free work and learning opportunity network with advertised zero-data access on the SA Youth platform.

watchOut: Linked external websites may use data. Registering does not guarantee a job, interview or place on a programme.

freeDetails: Participating eCentres provide free computer and internet use, up to ten printed pages per person per day, and training options.

watchOut: Western Cape locations only. Check the official facility listing before travelling; free training availability can vary.

freeDetails: Free preparation material and the Core Humanitarian Certification assessment.

watchOut: The credential is not a job offer, professional licence or guarantee of deployment. Data and device costs remain.

name: NWU AI for Academic and Career Success
bestFor: NWU students with access to the university’s eFundi learning system
freeDetails: A free two-hour self-paced AI course, with an NWU AI certificate and a personal career plan after successful completion.
requirements: Use the graduate-student course link on NWU’s AI training page and sign in through the university learning system.
watchOut: This guide is for eligible NWU institutional users. It does not promise public enrolment for people outside NWU or the separate lecturer incentive.

name: Digify PRO Foundations
bestFor: South Africans aged 18–35 building introductory digital-marketing skills
freeDetails: Free introductory digital-skills learning through the Digify PRO Foundations route.
requirements: Be aged 18–35 in South Africa, complete the official interest/application form and follow the programme’s access instructions.
watchOut: Foundations applications are described as year-round. Progression to later phases requires completing the preceding phase and meeting selection requirements.

name: Second Chance Matric revision resources
bestFor: Learners preparing to improve or complete eligible matric subjects
freeDetails: Official study guides, revision material and other learning support for matric preparation.
requirements: Use the DBE’s Second Chance resources and confirm your separate examination eligibility and registration with the education authorities.
watchOut: Access to revision material does not register you for an exam. The August–October 2026 teaching period has ended; check current dates before seeking a class.

name: YES × Microsoft AI learning and conditional exam vouchers
bestFor: South Africans completing eligible Microsoft AI learning paths
freeDetails: Free AI learning with a conditional route to one funded certification examination voucher, subject to the programme’s requirements and allocation.
requirements: Use the official programme, have a South African ID and Microsoft Learn profile, complete the specified modules, score at least 70% on the practice assessment and submit the required survey and evidence.
watchOut: A claim does not guarantee a voucher or immediate availability. The announced 50,000 allocation is not a live stock count. The separate Takealot prize draw ended on 31 October 2026.

name: Mopani Baby Club: information pack and qualifying baby bag
bestFor: Expecting parents able to use Mopani’s Mpumalanga stores
freeDetails: Joining provides an information welcome pack. A separate baby bag becomes available after R1,250 qualifying spend on an active Baby Club/Mopani Card profile.

watchOut: The product bag requires paid shopping and contents vary with stock. The blog says in-store collection, while current terms also mention dispatch with a qualifying online purchase; confirm dispatch directly before relying on delivery.

name: Melomed Melobabes pregnancy programme
bestFor: Expecting parents planning maternity care at a participating Melomed hospital
freeDetails: The programme advertises complimentary antenatal classes, pregnancy information and a downloadable journal. On maternity admission, members receive a nappy bag with nappies and selected toiletries.
requirements: Register through the official Melobabes page and ask the chosen hospital’s Client Service Officer about class dates and local benefit availability.
watchOut: The bag is linked to hospital admission; private maternity care is paid. Benefits vary by hospital. Registration does not guarantee every listed service at every facility.
